name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Trained as a mechanical engineer in Zagreb, he initially worked on industrial ventilation systems. A chance encounter with a former Formula 1 aerodynamicist sparked his interest in wind tunnel technology. He quickly realized the precision and dedication required in motorsport aligned perfectly with his skills. Marko joined Stewart-Haas Racing 12 years ago, starting as a junior operator, and quickly rose through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and knack for spotting subtle airflow anomalies. 

Marko thrives in the high-pressure environment of the wind tunnel. He is known for his unwavering focus, spending hours analyzing data and meticulously calibrating equipment. His ability to identify minute inconsistencies that could affect aerodynamic performance is highly valued by the team. Marko's methodical nature and commitment to precision make him an invaluable asset to Stewart-Haas Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with wind tunnel data and sketches.
Has a habit of humming quietly while operating the wind tunnel.
Insists on cleaning his workstation at the end of every shift, regardless of how busy the day was.
